locked_route.first_bad_edge: The frozen D>=(mu/16)I edge is exactly equivalent, via whitening, to K(A)>=(mu/16)A^(-1). It is therefore the unresolved C051-strength one-epoch certificate, not a weaker direct-C050 moment bridge.
locked_route.exact_falsifier_outcome: The edge survived the commuting, all-n equicorrelation, rational anisotropic noncommuting, and signed/block controls.
locked_route.reopen_if: A different run supplies either a general proof of D>=(mu/16)I or an exact/certified unit-diagonal SPD counterexample to that exact inequality.

repair_child.representation: The self-adjoint positive epoch covariance map Phi(X)=E[Q_pi X Q_pi^T], its multi-epoch orbit H_m=Phi^m(I), and the independent-replica noncommutative trace polynomial tr(H_m^p).
repair_child.state_or_invariant: H_k=Phi^k(I), the cumulative loss I-H_m=sum_{j=0}^{m-1}Phi^j(I-Phi(I)), and the logarithmic-order normalized Schatten moment tau(H_m^p) with p=ceil(log n).
information_retained: Exact update and transpose orientation inside every epoch
The full PSD matrix orbit of I rather than scalar traces alone
The n^(1/p) factor in moment-to-worst-state transfer
information_discarded: Full covariance-superoperator modes not reached from I
Pathwise distributions beyond the multi-epoch second-moment orbit
A fixed one-epoch A-energy contraction requirement
Any assumption that epoch factors commute
repair_child.core_candidate_lemma: For every n>=2 and every real unit-diagonal SPD A with mu=lambda_min(A), if m=ceil(1/mu), p=ceil(log n), H_m=Phi^m(I), and tau=tr/n, then tau(H_m^p)<=exp(-p/2).
repair_child.finite_and_structured_support: E2 exact finite checks, including two points on a fully coupled signed n=8,p=3 ray, plus E3 proofs for all 2x2 instances, all 7x7 instances at p=2, the full positive/negative equicorrelation ranges, and the full rational anisotropic noncommuting ray; these do not raise the unrestricted statement above E0.
repair_child.target_implication: Apply the candidate to arbitrarily many block-diagonal copies of a fixed A. The normalized p-th trace root is unchanged except that p=ceil(log N) tends to infinity, so it converges to lambda_max(H_m) and gives H_m<=exp(-1/2)I. Since m<=2/mu, positivity and block iteration give E||x_k||_A<=exp(1/4)exp(-mu*k/8)||x_0||_A for every initial point, hence C050 with C=exp(1/4), c=1/8.
repair_child.target_semantics: expected A-distance via Jensen from worst-initial-state second moment; never distance of the expected iterate
repair_child.non_normal_prefactor_control: The finite block Loewner bound on H_m is iterated by positivity, giving prefactor exp(1/4) independently of dimension and eigenvector conditioning.
repair_child.first_bad_edge: Prove the replica trace inequality uniformly without replacing H_m by H_1^m and without promoting a raw trace estimate to operator control.
repair_child.next_candidate_sublemma: For X=H_k, Y=H_(k+1), E=X-Y, retain the exact nonlinear interpolation tr(X^p)-tr(Y^p)=p*integral_0^1 tr((Y+tE)^(p-1)E)dt and bound the full integral from RPCD frame/word structure. The t=0 endpoint bound is false with every universal positive coefficient on negative equicorrelation.
repair_child.analytic_falsifier: The anisotropic eps=1/1000 instance has H_2-H_1^2 indefinite; any proposed proof using a commuting-power comparison is rejected. Direct-sum replication shows the uniform moment lemma is equivalent to the block operator bound H_m<=exp(-1/2)I, so trace averaging cannot hide one slow block. The positive equicorrelation delta=n^-2 family also shows raw fixed-dimension trace/Loewner conversion loses order n.
open_objections: No general mechanism currently yields the p-fold exponent in the replica trace polynomial.
Individual p=3 RPCD replica words can have negative trace even for positive equicorrelation, so termwise positivity is unavailable from the first genuinely unresolved moment order onward.
The exact p=2 identity tr(H_m^2)=tr(H_(2m)) does not extend to the useful upper bound tr(H_m^p)<=tr(H_(mp)): an exact 2x2 p=3 instance has strict reverse difference 99/40000000000.
Direct-sum amplification proves that the uniform trace-moment statement is equivalent to a finite block operator contraction; trace averaging does not make the endpoint logically weaker.
The candidate is stronger than the minimum block condition needed for C050 and may fail even if C050 is true.
The use of second moments remains stronger than expected-distance control and could miss a first-moment-only route.
Only a different-run hostile audit may raise the transfer proof above E3, and the candidate lemma itself is unproved.
repair_child.reopen_or_next_condition: Derive a dimension-free p-replica loss inequality for p=ceil(log n), or produce an exact/certified counterexample to the displayed trace-moment bound.

phase3_depth_child.representation: For the unchanged covariance orbit H_j=Phi^j(I), set X=H_j, Y=H_(j+1), and C_j=X^(-1/2)YX^(-1/2) on supp(X). Retain the positive relative-survival trace tr(X^p C_j^p).
phase3_depth_child.state_or_invariant: The orbit H_j, the relative-loss spectral measure nu_j(S)=tr[H_j^p E_(I-C_j)(S)]/tr(H_j^p), and the multiplicative ratios r_j=tr(H_j^p C_j^p)/tr(H_j^p).
information_retained: All noncommutative orientation through the exact pair H_j,H_(j+1)
The full nonlinear saturation 1-(1-t)^p of relative loss
information_discarded: Individual signed p-replica words after their assembled trace is bounded by ALT
phase3_depth_child.proved_reduction: Araki-Lieb-Thirring gives tr(H_(j+1)^p)<=r_j tr(H_j^p), so sum_(j<m)-log(r_j)>=p/2 implies the selected moment lemma. Also tr(X^p)-tr(Y^p)>=(1-exp(-1))tr[X^p min{p(I-C_j),I}].
phase3_depth_child.core_candidate_lemma: For m=ceil(1/mu), p=ceil(log n), and the reachable RPCD covariance orbit, sum_(j=0)^(m-1)-log(r_j)>=p/2.
phase3_depth_child.finite_and_structured_support: The stronger local sublemma is proved at j=0 when mu<=2/(np), survived two exact Rational noncommuting/signed stresses, and had no hit in a seeded 3,403-step float64 scout. These facts do not raise the unrestricted cumulative lemma above E0.
phase3_depth_child.target_implication: The cumulative lemma gives tau(H_m^p)<=exp(-p/2); the already proved direct-sum amplification gives H_m<=exp(-1/2)I; block iteration and Jensen give C050 with C=exp(1/4), c=1/8 for every initial point.
phase3_depth_child.target_semantics: expected A-distance via worst-state second moment and Jensen, with fresh independent epoch permutations
phase3_depth_child.non_normal_prefactor_control: unchanged finite block Loewner control after direct-sum amplification
phase3_depth_child.first_bad_edge: Prove a dimension-uniform small-relative-loss bound for the orbit-weighted measures nu_j, cumulatively through ceil(1/mu) steps.
analytic_falsifiers: An exact 2x2 matrix shows the ALT trace inequality cannot be promoted to Loewner order: trace residual 27/160, determinant -15129/2560000.
An abstract n=8 spectrum compatible with the inherited one-epoch floor and two-prefix trace bound violates the local half-mu cubic estimate by 571/1024, so those scalar summaries are insufficient.
Seek an exact/certified reachable orbit step with r_j>(1-mu/2)^p to refute only the stronger local sublemma.
open_objections: The cumulative relative-survival inequality is unproved and may be almost as strong as the selected endpoint moment certificate.
A first moment of the relative-loss measure does not control its small-loss mass and cannot yield p-fold decay.
The per-step local sublemma is stronger than necessary and could fail despite a valid cumulative estimate.
No different-run audit or independent reconstruction has checked the new reduction.
phase3_depth_child.reopen_or_next_condition: Prove a reachable-orbit small-ball estimate strong enough for the cumulative logarithmic loss, or give an exact/certified reachable counterexample to the local or cumulative statement with its scope explicitly separated from C050.
